title: Materials: add a cited library of nine structural metals
body:
Closes #99. Adds a fixed, cited catalogue of nine structural metals through `model.material.library.list` and `model.material.library`, available in the desktop Material menu, CLI, scripts and MCP. Entries become ordinary editable SI materials. Display units use the existing Quantity boundary; missing properties remain absent and strengths are informational, with no automatic plasticity or failure model.

The catalogue identifies each of its 54 selected values by source document, edition, table/clause and page, plus its basis and product/temperature applicability. EN standards are cited by number and edition without download URLs; the eight EN 1993-1-4 citations identify the standard itself, with the mismatched dissertation links removed. MIL-HDBK-5H links to the official [DLA catalogue](https://quicksearch.dla.mil/qsDocDetails.aspx?ident_number=53876), retaining the explicit 1998/Change Notice 1 (2001) citation and distinction from superseding 5J. NASA and manufacturer citations retain their original publisher links. No numerical value, basis, unit or applicability statement changed in this review revision.

Complete bibliographic citations can omit `source.url`. A supplied URL must still be HTTPS. The command report and serialization preserve citations with or without a link; regressions cover that contract.

Validation on Linux CPU at `442f06bf532d8f79c8f410b76a342f0332b42316`:

- `cargo check -p fieldcraft-model -p fieldcraft-engine`.
- Model suite: 107 passed, zero failed; engine suite: 385 passed, zero failed, 15 heavy tests ignored. Model/engine documentation compilation also passed (no examples).
- `cargo clippy -p fieldcraft-model -p fieldcraft-engine --all-targets -- -D warnings`, formatting and diff checks.
- Manual simplification review; both original logical commits retained after autosquashing review fixes and the SI plausibility-bound follow-up. The tested tree is unchanged by history cleanup; the generated feature page matches the catalogue exactly.

The catalogue contains room-temperature constant isotropic approximations, not temperature-dependent curves or procurement/design allowables. The stress-free reference temperature is an explicit modelling choice, defaulting to 20 degrees Celsius. This revision performs no GPU or native desktop validation, no full local CI gate and no solver numerical/fixture changes.

Historical demonstration: [native video](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/881cd393-551b-4b3c-b74e-5aeb22cbd98c), [library form](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/44a63a9b-164b-4fc7-b3f8-3e780d870a6e), [conductor](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6ce53009-1329-4941-97a0-fa6580e29934). These remain original captures from `35ef3b12c7fb78cd1065042e9667736cb2cd15a9`, with a CPU solve and NVIDIA RTX4090 Vulkan viewport, not recordings of this head. Native executable SHA256: `f6a141336ef485c7ae1aaeb517f266d78f804651c986366045069a94851a5542`; CLI SHA256: `98be90a58502311e43f761b5708dbb5a3e2d6e73d9d48fca4f700bf0aab6952f`. Maintainer applicability review remains pending; historical source-link text differs from this revision. No media files are committed to feature history.

The original runnable `docs/materials/conduction.json` builds a 20x30x120 mm 304 stainless bar with constant 15 W/(m K) conductivity, insulated sides and 20/30 Celsius ends. Its closed-form implementation check is midpoint 298.15 K, axial flux -1250 W/m2 and opposite endpoint heat rates 0.75 W; it is not experimental material validation or coupled-exchanger accuracy.

reviews.author: jyviko
reviews.body:
Thank you, a cited library is something we really want, and the values check out (e.g. 2024-T3 0.100 lb/in³ = 2768 kg/m³, the NASA moduli). The sources need to change before it can go in, though:

- **16 URLs in `crates/model/data/materials.json`** point to what look like unauthorised copies of CEN standards (`gfos.unios.hr` for EN 1993-1-1, `phd.eng.br` for EN 1993-1-2 and EN 1999-1-1). **3 more** point to a studylib upload of MIL-HDBK-5H. We can't link those.
- **8 entries cite "EN 1993-1-4"** but link to a University of Macau dissertation PDF.

Please cite standards by number and edition with no URL, or with the official CEN/ASSIST page. Anything taken from the thesis should cite and link the thesis itself.

Also, `ab7b8246` is a fixup commit, so please autosquash it.
